title: Better Chiseled Stone Bricks
description: Centers the middle of the chiseled stone bricks!
body:
# Better Chiseled Stone Bricks v1.0

Have you ever been annoyed by the fact that blocks like walls, torches, iron bars, etc don't align properly with chiseled stone bricks? Then this pack is for you!

![BCSB](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bed5c964c3f960814450a199c802875c29395020.png)

**This pack makes the center part of Chiseled Stone Bricks to be an even number long instead of odd. This makes the block align better with other blocks such as walls that are placed on top of it.**

Buut there is a _small_ problem. It doesn't tile together like it used to. But let's be honest, when's the last time you placed a whole bunch of chiseled stone bricks together _only_ for design and NOT for something like giant pixel art? Yeah. I thought so.

By the way, **this pack works with 26.2** (or at least i hope so. It worked in the snapshots) and shows _NO ERRORS_ from version 1.21 to 26.2! (hurray!)

Here is an image that shows the tiling issue when this pack is enabled - 
![tiling issue](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e90eacf2de64a913d132968140de02251b49aeb0.png)
I am thinking about changing the shading of the texture so that the highlights are more prominent, because then it would tile better. But, It would look kinda different from the vanilla texture. I don't know, maybe I'll do it in v2.0!

But be honest, almost nobody uses _only_ chiseled stone bricks as a floor/wall design. Almost all the time, chiseled stone bricks are either pretty isolated with no other of the same block around it, or its placed at a distance from nearby chiseled stone bricks. In both cases, the vanilla texture looks off.
This pack fixes that. So download it. or don't, if you don't want to.

![made by interdime](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7f4cd1e6749f1e3d58b0d7af6ffc76f7b5e43144.png)

_Yaaay centered chiseled stone bricks_
